7: from .constants import ADMIN_ACCESS
8: from .constants import READ_ONLY_ACCESS

10: 
11: class TeamManagerBase(models.Manager):
12:     """Manager to control team's access."""
13: 
14:     def teams_for_user(self, user, organization, admin, member):
15:         teams = self.get_queryset().none()
16:         if admin:
17:             # Project Team Admin
18:             teams |= user.teams.filter(access=ADMIN_ACCESS)
19: 
20:             # Org Admin
21:             for org in user.owner_organizations.all():
22:                 teams |= org.teams.all()
23: 
24:         if member:
25:             # Project Team Member
26:             teams |= user.teams.filter(access=READ_ONLY_ACCESS)
27: 
28:         if organization:
29:             teams = teams.filter(organization=organization)
30: 
31:         return teams.distinct()
